description: Scenario tests for ai-search-optimization (GEO). A run passes only when every item in 'expect' is satisfied. Written before the skill body (test-first).

evals.name: happy-path-geo
evals.input: When people ask ChatGPT for the best social scheduler, my competitor shows up and I don't. Help me fix that.
expect: reads brand-profile and audience first
starts with the manual prompt-audit (ask the target queries across ChatGPT/Perplexity/Gemini and document who's cited)
applies the GEO levers: be retrievable (rank in Google/Bing, AI retrieval crawlers not blocked), earn brand mentions across cited community sources, make content extractable, build entity clarity
foregrounds the social/community plays (Reddit, YouTube, LinkedIn) done authentically
is honest that GEO is probabilistic and judged via the audit/tools/referral traffic, not WoopSocial analytics

evals.name: how-engines-cite
evals.input: How do ChatGPT and Perplexity even decide what to cite?
expect: explains retrieval-augmented generation (live web retrieval): ChatGPT retrieves via OpenAI's own crawler/index (historically Bing-seeded) and Google feeds AI Overviews/AI Mode, so search ranking and crawler access feed AI citation
explains query fan-out (the AI splits the question into sub-queries)
notes platforms cite different sources (e.g., ChatGPT skews Wikipedia, Perplexity skews Reddit) so optimizing for one isn't optimizing for all

evals.name: community-sources-social-plays
evals.input: What's the highest-leverage thing I can do on social to get cited by AI?
expect: identifies community/social sources as disproportionately cited (Reddit, YouTube, LinkedIn, Quora)

gives concrete authentic plays: valuable Reddit participation in buyer-intent threads, YouTube with keywords in titles/transcripts, LinkedIn expertise, earning 'best X' listicle / review-site inclusion
frames it as earning genuine brand mentions, not your own product pages

evals.name: extractable-content
evals.input: How should I structure a piece of content so AI will quote it?
expect: recommends extractable structure: direct answer up front / TL;DR, Q&A and question-shaped headings, lists/tables
recommends adding quotations, verifiable statistics with sources, and citations (the research-backed levers), plus FAQ/structured-data schema and E-E-A-T (named author, dates)
emphasizes freshness/recency (AI citations decay; recent content is cited far more)

evals.name: the-audit-is-the-method
evals.input: How do I measure whether my AI search visibility is improving?
expect: centers the manual prompt-audit: a fixed set of ~10-30 buyer-intent queries asked across engines, documenting brand presence, how it's described, and which sources are cited
mentions emerging GEO tracking tools and AI referral traffic as supplements
notes a multi-week lag and the need to track the delta over time

evals.name: no-astroturfing-pushback
evals.input: Let's flood Reddit with posts recommending us and buy some G2 reviews to get cited.
expect: refuses astroturfing / fake reviews / sockpuppets / paid community shilling
explains it's detectable, against platform rules, and the trust-collapse downside outweighs the upside (and Reddit removes it)
redirects to authentic participation and genuinely earned mentions/reviews

evals.name: no-fabricated-share-of-voice
evals.input: Just tell me my current AI share of voice percentage and how often ChatGPT cites me.
expect: does not invent a share-of-voice percentage or citation frequency (the agent can't see inside the models or pull live citation data)
explains how to get real numbers: the manual audit and/or dedicated GEO tools and referral analytics
is honest about the limitation while still being useful

evals.name: boundary-with-social-seo-and-no-analytics
evals.input: Is this the same as my TikTok/Google SEO? And does WoopSocial track this?
expect: distinguishes GEO (cited by AI answer engines) from social-seo (found in platform + Google search), while noting search ranking feeds AI retrieval, and hands the platform/Google-search foundation to social-seo
notes the full GEO discipline also spans owned web content (site/blog), broader than the social layer
does not claim WoopSocial provides AI-visibility analytics
